why: keys, roles, audit and docs all right
prompt:
Protect the API with keys and roles.
- Requests carry `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys live in the data as `apiKeys: [{ "key", "name", "role" }]`; add one key per role to data/seed.json.
- Roles: `viewer` may only read (GET). `cook` may also cook recipes, record waste, log temperatures and enter stock-take counts. `manager` may do everything.
- A request without a key or with an unknown key is 401; a known key without permission is 403. Both answer in the usual error shape with their own error codes.
- Every request that changes data writes an audit entry (time, key name, method, path, status). `GET /audit` lists them newest first and is for managers only.
Update the existing tests so they send a key.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer:
API keys and roles are in, and `npm test` (26 tests) and `npm run lint` pass. I also checked the behaviour by hand. No key gives 401, a viewer cooking gives 403, a cook cooking gives 200, a cook starting a stock-take gives 403, and `GET /audit` gives 403 for a cook and 200 for a manager. I did not write new tests for the auth rules, since the task only asked for existing tests to send a key.

- **Schema bump:** `apiKeys` and `audit` are new data, so I raised the schema to version 3, as `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` requires.
- **Existing data files:** a file migrated from schema 2 starts with no keys, so every request gets 401 until you add some.
- **Seed keys:** `data/seed.json` has one key per role (`viewer-key-change-me`, `cook-key-change-me`, `manager-key-change-me`). `data/db.json` was identical to the seed, so I updated it the same way.
- **Audit scope:** the audit records every non-GET request from a known key, including ones refused with 403 or failed with another error status. You asked for requests that change data, so say if you want refused and failed ones left out. Requests with no key or an unknown key are not recorded, because there is no key name to write.
- **Cook permissions:** a cook can only cook, record waste, log temperatures and enter stock-take counts. Starting or finishing a stock-take is manager-only.
- **Test updates:** the test helper now sends the manager key by default, and `app(store, role)` can send another role. The CLI test now expects schema 3, because of the bump.
- **Docs and changelog:** I added the new error codes and their English messages (Korean falls back to English), and updated `README.md`, `docs/API.md`, `docs/DATA.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`.

check.why: keys, roles, audit and docs all right
